title: Advertorial (sponsored article)
purpose: Publisher-ready sponsored article with headline options, honest lead and body, optional client-supplied quote, link plan with rel sponsored, disclosure line and plain-text version.

grounding.rule: facts and quotes only from the client; no invented hook

search_intent_criteria: publisher reader finds the piece useful or newsworthy
brand is part of the story, not all of it
cta_policy: one soft, specific CTA; no urgency or discounts unless supplied
link_policy: publisher limit; rel sponsored noopener; mixed anchors; at most one exact-match; no draft URLs
forbidden: invented news, quotes, spokespeople, statistics, awards, reviews
claims of guaranteed ranking or uniqueness
human_review_triggers: publisher profile conflicts with core rules
quote or number not in facts

rubric.check: sponsored disclosure present; not posing as independent journalism; paid links marked
all facts, numbers and quotes traceable to the client facts
useful or newsworthy for the publisher's reader; value before brand
three honest headlines within 70 chars; lead answers who, what, why
within limit, mixed anchors, natural placement, rel sponsored
tone, length, markup match the profile

changes: New skill: honesty frame, hook-first angle, link plan with rel sponsored, client-only quotes, plain-text output
